decisions.reason: The adjustable quarter-pallet shelf display sits close to the firm's core cardboard display knowledge, and in-house R&D lets management interpret results and refine it.
The pegboard-back shelf display is a small extension of the established cardboard display offer that the firm can readily assimilate and improve.
The standard quarter-pallet shelf display is core to the firm's knowledge base and production capacity, so it is likely retained.
The eighth-pallet display is a close variant of the existing formats and draws on established design and manufacturing know-how.
Wood is further from the firm's paper-based expertise, but it builds on its display know-how and R&D, so it is likely kept despite more uncertainty.
The media-product quarter-pallet display applies the core cardboard competence to a specific segment, which the firm can learn from and adapt.
